ex.s: But to celebrate this festival, we prepare Chinese dishes, too.

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师可以打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和精美的装饰件用于婚礼蛋糕上。不是每个人都能做到——这需要多年经验，但打印机让这变得容易。西班牙一家餐厅使用Foodini来“重现”食物的“完全相同”的形状，让厨师能去完成其他任务。在另一家餐厅，它供应的所有菜肴和甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 被扔掉的完好食物数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒收的“丑陋”（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜，到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的未吃完的菜肴。

defs.def: to serve food onto plates for a meal 把（食物）分到盘里（以便用餐）

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。
